simple.summary: נֶפֶל (nephel) means something fallen , i.e. an abortion First listed occurrence: Eccl 6 3.

definitions.full: H5309. nephel נֵ֫פֶל noun masculine Job 3:16 untimely birth, abortion ; — נֵ֫פֶל absolute 3:16 (Baer, Ginsb., > van d. H. נֶפֶל ), נָ֑פֶל Eccl 6:3 ; construct אֵשֶׁת נֵפֶל Psa 58:9 .
